content.short: Manticore is a symbolic execution tool for the analysis of Ethereum smart contracts and binaries.
content.description: Released in 2017 by TrailOfBits, Manticore is a symbolic execution tool designed to analyze Ethereum smart contracts, Linux ELF binaries, and WASM modules. It automatically generates new inputs based on a program state, detects crashes and failure cases, and explores the states a program can reach. With instruction hooks and callbacks, developers gain precise control of state exploration. Manticore includes a wiki, examples, and an API reference to help users fully leverage its interface.
